newsitem.title: FRANCE: Havas seeks peace with Albert Frere.
newsitem.headline: Havas seeks peace with Albert Frere.

text.p: Havas chairman Pierre Dauzier said he had started talks to conclude peace with Belgian businessman Albert Frere with which the company had fallen out last summer during various television merger talks.
Dauzier told a news conference on Thursday that he wanted that holding company Audiofina, controlled by Frere, would remain a shareholder in Havas.

He also said he was in talks about the future of CLMM, a holding company which has a stake in Audiofina and which is 40-percent owned by Havas and the rest by Frere-controlled companies Electrafina and Groupe Bruxelles Lambert.
A company source said Havas would like to merge CLMM with the listed Audiofina group, which is a key shareholder in broadcaster CLT/UFA.
In a second stage, the Frere companies could buy Havas' stake in Audiofina, the source added.
